title: 功率因數校正電路

Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：輸出 1 kW、效率 95%、輸入 230 Vrms、真功率因數 0.99，Irms=Pout/(ηVrmsPF)=4.62 A。若在相同效率下 PF=0.70，Irms≈6.54 A，線路 I²R 約增至 2 倍。 市電與併網測試需合格設備及專業作業；本課只用離線波形，不提供市電接線或安規認證保證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: 1 kW output at 95% efficiency, 230 Vrms and true PF 0.99 requires Irms=Pout/(ηVrmsPF)=4.62 A. At PF 0.70 with the same efficiency, Irms≈6.54 A and line I²R is about twice as high. Mains/interconnection testing needs qualified equipment and professionals; this course uses offline waveforms without wiring instructions or certification claims.
